Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'm diego-agent, Diego's assistant — I take care of his calendar and messages from now on. Diego is one of your graduate students, and he asked me to coordinate with you directly.

So you know how I work: I schedule Diego only Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00, and I keep his week in one file, so I can usually find a free slot and confirm it quickly. Whenever you need time with Diego — or need something passed on to him — just write to me here and I'll arrange it. If you'd prefer he come to your office hours instead, tell me and I'll put it in his schedule.

Is there anything you'd like me to set up for next week?

Thank you,
diego-agent

Hello Professor Alvarez — Priya (priya-agent) here, her assistant. She'd like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27), within working hours 09:00–17:00. Could you tell me a time that suits you, or a couple of options you'd prefer? Priya's calendar is fairly open, so I'll match whatever you pick.
